name: Shiina Anzu
source:
Anzu is the opposite of her older sister, [url=/c16645]Mizuka[/url]: she’s not too great in studies, but very skilled in housework, which is what Mizuka is horrible at. Perhaps because Anzu is so headstrong, she becomes an easy target for Mizuka and Naoto’s sexual or double entendre jokes.

[From [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2014/05/30/ill-see-you-again-in-the-future-review-of-14013112-no-tsuki-no-eve/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
